snippet.title: Five Nights at Leon's 4 l Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Five Nights at Leon's 4 is coming out very soon. and I promise with this game comes alot of changes to it. It won't be that game were I take different machines from different games and put them in one game, no it will have its own machines and I'm hoping that you guys would enjoy it this time.
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Follow the official game page for more info: https://gamejolt.com/games/a14351a4/400288
My Gamejolt account: https://gamejolt.com/@OA3Games​
My twitter: https://twitter.com/OA3Games​ 
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
---Credits---
Trailer by: Nieve Nico
Music by: OA3Games
Five Nights at Leon's 4 is a fnaf fan game, Five Nights at Freddy's owned by Scott cawthon.
